summary: 固定目标训练均值和尺度后未形成稳定改善：K5目标参考自适应AUC，SRPBS79为0.7088、Emo53为0.5456；相对原策略差值分别为-0.0172、-0.0225，两项描述性配对95%区间均包含0。
boundary: 4320新分类拟合（480最终/3840内层），2196原头完整复用；全部6516保存头独立复算，训练参考复用原366。原20评分、QC变动及新增独立临床验证均0，偏头痛候选分类仍0。
analysis_type: post hoc target-only training normalization sensitivity on developed cohorts
uncertainty: 2000 paired person-within-class and support-draw resamples shared by both policies; no additional fits; descriptive development intervals
scaler_policy: Class-balanced target training supports only, fixed across supervised alpha within the same reference and fold; source-only unchanged
limitations: Post hoc cohorts already developed. The standardization rule alone changes, while realized inner selections can change. Reference/fold coordinates differ. No isolated biological cause, unseen cohort or clinical increment is established.

objective_verification.objective_formula: sum(w_i * (logaddexp(0, x_i theta) - y_i * x_i theta)) + lambda/2 * ||theta||^2
objective_verification.gap_bound: ||gradient||_2^2 / (2 * lambda), from lambda-strong convexity in the augmented standardized coordinates
objective_verification.interpretation: 本次目标残差测量没有再次拟合或改变选择。浮点梯度上界约束增广凸目标，不能换算成AUC误差或临床增量；同参考、同折且同lambda才固定原坐标惩罚。
